name: Completer
author: nphil
about: Checks with the news servers, before anything is downloaded, whether a new download can be completed, and fails the ones that cannot so that Sonarr, Radarr and friends pick another release.
requirements: Completer must be in NZBGet's Extensions list (global), so that it runs for every new download and its scheduled check can run.
description: Completer asks your news servers whether the articles of a new download exist (a STAT question; nothing is downloaded).

A download that cannot be repaired is failed at once, the way NZBGet itself fails it, so Sonarr and Radarr blocklist the release and search again. A download that can be completed is released within seconds.
Only the one new download is ever held, and only until it has been checked. Any problem, on the servers or inside Completer, lets the download go.
Start in DryRun: nothing is held or changed, and the Report button shows how Completer's verdicts compare with what NZBGet really did.

options.name: Mode
description: What Completer does with its verdict.
DryRun: checks every new download and writes the verdict into the log and into the download's parameters. Nothing is held, paused or failed.
Enforce: new downloads are held while they are checked, released when they pass and failed when they cannot be completed.
Off: checks nothing and lets go of anything it still holds.

options.name: Categories
description: Only downloads in these categories are checked (comma separated).
Leave empty to check every category.

options.name: FreshHours
description: How long after it was posted a download counts as fresh (hours, 0 to 72).

Articles of a very new post may not have reached every server yet, so a fresh download that looks incomplete is held and checked again (after 10, 20, 40 and 60 minutes) instead of being failed at once.
The check after the fresh time is over is final.
Default = 2.

options.name: Connections
description: How many connections Completer opens to one news server while it checks (1 to 8).
It never uses more than the connections you gave that server in NZBGet. Servers that already use all their connections for downloading may refuse extra ones; use the TestServers button to find out.
Default = 2.

options.name: MaxArticles
description: The most articles Completer asks about for one download (100 to 20000).
It starts with a small sample and stops as soon as the answer is certain, so most downloads need far fewer. Posts with 200 articles or fewer are checked completely.
Default = 1200.

options.name: TimeLimit
description: The most seconds one check may take (10 to 300).
When time runs out without a certain answer, the download is let through.
Default = 45.

options.name: MaxFillPercent
description: Fail a download when more than this share of it (percent) exists only on fill servers, the servers in a level above the first. Block accounts cost money per download.
100 switches this off.
Default = 100.

options.name: IgnoreServers
description: Numbers of NZBGet news servers that Completer never asks, for example 3, 7-11.
Leave empty to use every active server.

options.name: Verbose
description: Write the details of every check into NZBGet's log: how many questions each server answered and how long it took.
Default = no.

commands.name: TestServers
description: Log in to every news server with as many connections as a check uses, and say how it went.
Press it while NZBGet is downloading to find out whether the servers have connections to spare.

commands.name: Report
description: Compare what Completer said about downloads in NZBGet's history with what NZBGet finally did: right calls, false alarms, misses and the amount of data saved.

commands.name: ReleaseAll
description: Let every download that Completer holds start now.
Press this before you remove Completer from NZBGet's Extensions list or uninstall it.
